integrity: The constants follow from an analytic continuant and Schur-complement proof. Supplementary checks are finite and do not replace the proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem treats only the specified half-integral three-periodic potential and the symmetric Dirichlet cutoffs N=3k+1; no uniform perturbation bound is proved. Other general edge-tunneling results may imply this exact instance.
title: Sharp edge-mode splitting in a three-periodic finite-section counterexample
